findings.text: The new census anchor cites the bank operand cache as logs/existing-operand-cache.npz; the instrument default (benchmarks/program_shape_census.py:32) and both receipts name logs/exact-operand-cache.npz, and only that file exists (180876 bytes in this worktree), so a reader following the anchor lands on a citation they cannot open. Introduced by cb5c6661.

The source line still states logs/exact-operand-cache.npz as '(89486 bytes, allow_pickle=False)'; the file is 180876 bytes and 89486 matches no member size, no uncompressed total (273968) and no file size — it matches the gid that ls -la prints in the group column next to the real size (mcintos 89486 180876). Pre-existing rather than introduced here and not named by the node's fence, so it is recorded rather than counted in the scores.

justifications.durability: A check that fails on regression of every repaired assertion exists and was run at the landed head (gate_record_repairs.py), but it lives only in the run's reports directory and no committed artifact cites it, so nothing automatically fails if a later edit walks any of these records back; the repo holds no test binding the receipts' byte pairs or the research doc's design statements, which is the whole of the deduction.
justifications.evidence: The node's structural gate gate_record_repairs.py ran GATE PASS 25/25 (log: reports/nova/s19-local/census-record/gate-record-repairs.log), and I re-ran it first-hand against the reviewed worktree head at cb5c6661 (EXIT=0, 25/25, log: this run dir's gate-rerun.log) over exactly the repair assertions, including the self-consistency of the byte/GiB pair, and I reproduced the load-bearing numbers independently: flux 0.48208103 over all 66 pairs, both byte pairs divide to their stated GiB, the decomposition SVG decodes to the 120/74 labels with every bar matching read-0request-decomposition.json at a single scale per panel (8.98 px/unit left, 5.04 right) including both zero bars and the depth 2-13 and 1-12 spans, and the buckets SVG decodes to the caption's bar values (bank 1, certificate 4, per bucket 1 and 1) under 'today (5 programs)' and 'one per bucket (2)'. One point is withheld because the gate's 25 checks do not cover the new anchor's cited paths, which is how the finding survived a passing gate.
justifications.fit: Names follow the house rules with no version suffixes and no plan identifiers (read-request-decomposition.svg and .json, render_read_decomposition.py, render_figures_job.sh); the four commits use conventional subjects each with a body stating what changed and why and carry no attribution; the two figures follow the sibling evidence figures' committed renderer idiom, publish an SVG twin beside each PNG as the publishing convention requires, and their captions name every bar.
justifications.goal_fidelity: All six findings of f-msc-shape-census-record-repairs are repaired: bank-shape-identity.json:56 now reads flux_max_abs_difference 0.482 (my own recomputation over all 66 arm pairs from the persisted cache gives 0.48208103, with radius, height and wall exactly 0.0), its cache_inventory pair is now this file's own capture (lines 75-76: 20044389103 bytes = 18.667792 GiB, quoted as 18.668, distinct from the census receipt's self-consistent 20038219057 / 18.662 at program-shape-census.json:562-563), compile-cost-evidence.html:113 states one entry today not twelve, line 85 discloses the _UNIT_NODE name publication and points at framework_compat_shims (verified present at program-shape-census.json:7), line 110 states member width as an unmeasured assumption the bucket key must not rely on, and landed.html:731-747 carries both anchors with the plan landing comment at plans/millisecond-converged-solve.html:437 naming merge 39b8bedb. The deduction is the one introduced citation defect below; the record-repair work itself is complete and independently reproduced.
justifications.scope_discipline: The four commits (628478b6, 1c304b3d, 19b51854, cb5c6661) touch only docs/evidence/archive/millisecond-converged-solve-landed.html, docs/plans/millisecond-converged-solve.html, docs/research/compile-cost-evidence.html and four files under docs/figures/millisecond-converged-solve/program-shapes and /request-set, all inside the declared write paths; no __pycache__, .pyc or scratch file is committed, benchmarks/program_shape_census.py is untouched, and the roster commit c344bc33 (docs/state/nova/crew.json) is dispatch bookkeeping outside the four.
